# JADMaker

**Author:** Goh Mingkun

<div className="screenshot">

![JADMaker: screenshot 1](./jadmaker/img/jadmaker.png)

</div>

JADMaker creates a JAD descriptor file from the manifest of a finished JAR. It supports processing multiple files, dragging and dropping JAR files into the program window, and the `Make JAD` command in the Explorer context menu.
